text:
release-coordinator: deploy-bot blocked the release on preflight: keystore suffix appeared to be stripped in prod only, promotion paused. see deploy-bot output below.

deploy-bot: preflight-check FAILED for release v2026.03.21. reason: keystore_key_suffix_missing. path=/keystore/services/inference/credentials/ (expected trailing '-enc', found none)

anna: omg, we just ran the same preflight against staging minutes ago and it passed. any idea what changed between envs?

matt: quick question — was the keystore config templated from the helm chart or coming from the secret backfill job?

zach: looks like the secret-sync job ran last night and it applied a normalization script. it strips trailing hyphens from keys (legacy fix). might've affected prod only due to an older sync agent config.

lina: confirming: on staging `kubectl get secret inference-keystore -o jsonpath='{.data.keys}'` returns keys with `-enc` suffix. on prod the same command shows keys without suffix.

release-coordinator: @zach can you paste the sync job run log? this is blocking the release window if we can't guarantee env parity.

zach: log snippet: `2026-03-21T02:14Z secret-sync: normalizing keynames: strip_trailing_chars=true` — operator config used `strip_trailing_chars=true` on prod cluster only.

matt: ok that explains it. two options: 1) patch prod sync job to stop stripping (safer), backfill keys to add suffix, then resume rollout; 2) pin release to older keystore-keyname-agnostic variant or rollback. Given change window, option 2 might be faster.

anna: Are we able to pin the service to v2026.03.18 temporarily (it doesn't require `-enc` suffix)? If yes, we can avoid user impact and schedule a backfill ASAP.

sre-oncall: we should also consider rollback vs patch with infra — rollback buys time but masks the underlying divergence. I'd prefer patch+backfill if we can do it in the next 1.5h.

release-coordinator: decision: pause promotion to prod for the rest of the window. we'll pin the canary to v2026.03.18 for the downstream routes that already flipped and open an infra ticket to revert `strip_trailing_chars` on prod.

lina: I'll run the temporary pin in the next 5m: `kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=image:redwood/inference:v2026.03.18 --record` and retarget traffic rules.

zach: starting infra ticket and scheduling backfill: `ticket #INFRA-2468 created — revert flag and add backfill job: add_suffix='-enc'`. ETA for backfill ~ 45m.

deploy-bot: action recorded: promotion paused; pinned deployments: inference->v2026.03.18; ticket INFRA-2468 linked.

anna: also adding a note to release notes and the changelog that prod had a keystore normalization config drift. won't ship release notes for v2026.03.21 until parity is restored.

matt: please add a short postmortem stub so we don't repeat this: config flag difference between clusters got applied without a canary.

release-coordinator: agreed — I'll create the postmortem template and assign owners after the backfill completes. for now: promotion remains paused, pin in place, infra backfill running. status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

lina: backfill started — adding `-enc` suffix to 12 keys in prod now (dry-run logs look good).

zach: reverted `strip_trailing_chars` on prod sync agent and redeployed config (rolled in safe window).

lina: backfill finished, verification: production keys now include `-enc` suffix, smoke test of keystore lookup returns success.

release-coordinator: smoke tests pass. lifting hold in 10m and will re-run deploybot promotion. if deploy-bot still flags anything we abort and escalate.

deploy-bot: re-run preflight: all checks OK. promotion allowed.

release-coordinator: proceeding with promotion now. will publish postmortem link after release. thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
